customCards.name: Darkness ziod the magical Warr

customCards.name: Death Dragon Bear

customCards.desc: A young girl who just tapped into her power, be careful as if she is scared or angry she could freeze the earth into another ice age.

customCards.name: Elemental Spirt Fire
customCards.desc: A fire spirit that plays tricks on their prey before they die. It said it will transform into your love ones but on fire to lore their prey.

customCards.name: Field Medic

customCards.name: Giant Roach
customCards.desc: They are no longer interested in trash, they eat humans now. Now way a boot can stop these anymore.

customCards.name: Giant Snake
customCards.desc: A breed of snake that has slivered in the power plant on route 42 and it seems to have skin of diamond, survivors have not returned when they have been sent to Route 42.

customCards.name: Giant Spider
customCards.desc: Made in a lab and you do not want to be bit by one of these, you will not become spiderman, there will be no man left.

customCards.name: Robo Cano
customCards.desc: We do not know where these flying drone came from we think the SCP created them to spy on people.

customCards.desc: Younger brother to Savage Demon Gorzah Cozmet, Savage Demon Lukeage swore to protect the throne of The Savage Demons. Winning over 10000 battles alongside his brother fighting with America was his hardest battle, due to his grown love for humanity.

customCards.name: Savage Demon Magcal Mist
customCards.desc: One of the most powerful mages in the Savage Demons armies, said to burn villages with the wave of his hand.

customCards.name: Savage Demon Dezm
customCards.desc: Savage Demon Dezmi is the general of the Savage Demons said to be the closes with the legion and once fought and had a close battle with the angel Michael.

customCards.name: Scp Globen Guard
customCards.desc: A goblin who figured he wanted to change his life around and stop eating people now joined the SCP foundation as a Guard.

customCards.name: Scp Guard
customCards.desc: One of the grunts that is out there to cover up the dirty work for the SCP Foundation.

customCards.name: Scum boss

customCards.name: Scum Self Detonator
customCards.desc: The Crash Dummy of The Scum Gang

customCards.name: Scum Grunt
customCards.desc: These guys are nobodies..... That's all you have to know.

customCards.name: Spirit ball
customCards.desc: The soul of someone who lost their life in the flood.

customCards.name: ualti wizard of Elements
customCards.desc: The wizard that has saved the planet from Demons, Angels, gods and even Primordial beings, as humans do not know where he come from and the SCP did not capture him as they use him to protect him when SCP-682 breaks containment  ualti wizard of Elements is the best when it comes to magic. Rumors say that he learned from a goddess named Abraxas, people do not think she exist because she is claimed to be the true god.

customCards.desc: Said to be the brother of  Azathoth and the creator of realms. The power of this Primordial being is unmatched.

customCards.desc: People do not believe she exist, it is said she is the creator of everything we know and the creator of magic

customCards.name: Azathoth
customCards.desc: Some people said we live in this thing's dreams, some say if it wakes up, we will all be erased, it is said it more than one of this things for each galaxy. Who know what to believe.

customCards.name: SCP-999
customCards.desc: A happy goo, it is said that this thing that makes everyone happy is the protector of the earth. His father is the embodiment of evil, this is what the SCP foundation say will protect mankind from something that can destroy planets and stars.

customCards.name: Garden Of Eden
customCards.desc: Gain 1 kalon Source

customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: SCP-001 Crimson King
customCards.desc: Said to be one of the strongest threats to humanity this king is the ruler of the Savage Demons and is here to absorb the life force of Earth and the 1st galaxy from its power of Abraxas.

customCards.name: Scylla
customCards.desc: A beautiful woman who is said to lore women into deep waters and well....You never see those men again. The SCP Foundation only send women when it came to encountering this creature.

customCards.name: Haunted House
customCards.desc: A house From Philadelphia, to say it moves in the dusk and returns back to its spot before any human can realize it is gone. During blood moons it is said to transform into its true form and those who see the house move are never seen to ever confirm the house moves.

customCards.name: Sakla
customCards.desc: Something is strange with this dr here, word around the foundation this guy is posses with some type of demon or SCP because something about this guy is off.

customCards.name: Baby Gemas
customCards.desc: We need to destroy this thing; it is the beginning to the end of everything.

customCards.name: Abra Faries
customCards.desc: The apple these faries are said to create universes and give humans the knowledge of the universe, it is said that these apple are the same apples that Adam and Eve took a bite of.

customCards.name: Zarra The Infected Survivor
customCards.desc: One day Zarra went on a mission to check out the Alien ship that crashed in North Philadelphia, a far away from the camp. She hasn't come back and when we found her, this is what was of her.

customCards.name: Wasteland
customCards.desc: +5 DEF and +5 RES to ALL your units. Pure tank field — physical AND magical defense.

customCards.name: Mutant Dog
customCards.desc: Dog owner dogs that was wiped away from the flood happen to come back to them, well looking a little different.

customCards.name: SCP-076
customCards.desc: An SCP who said they were born before human creation, which is normally debated by people for hundreds of years. It's hard to believe that this guy killed his brother, and instead of jail, they put him in SCP Foundation's control.

customCards.name: Mr Ascend
customCards.desc: It is said that a man with a cube with a ring on his head approaches those whom he sees that can tap into their highest form of self, and he is said to grant humans the ability to take their talents to a level others couldn't imagine.

customCards.name: Commander Paul
customCards.desc: The commander of a business consultant company who comes off as a superhero live streamer.

customCards.name: What to cover today?
customCards.desc: Deals 100 damage to one unit, not too many surviving this.

customCards.name: Javier Deals
customCards.desc: Draw 3 cards and give your ally 1 strength

customCards.name: SCP-046
customCards.desc: The famous plague doctor, a very calm and cool guy. People are afraid of him, we just advise for you not to touch him or let him touch you.

customCards.name: SCP-2747
customCards.desc: No one knows much about her, but rumors say if you see her, there is a chance that she can erase you from the book you were written in, I have no clue what that means, but it sounds scary.

customCards.name: Camp Knight
customCards.desc: A guard that protects the camp gates.

customCards.name: SCP Knight
customCards.desc: A guard that protects the gates of the SCP foundation. These guys are roofless if you get close you might never walk again.

customCards.name: Contractor
customCards.desc: These guys are quick; no one knows who sends these guys, but when they come, it's a 50% chance you die, the other 50% well....They send them to try to kill gods, demons, and anomalies.

customCards.name: Hitman
customCards.desc: If you see one of these guys.... Do not worry; you wouldn't know it. Rest in Peace.

customCards.name: Sparta Spartan
customCards.desc: A camera man for a live stream. I have no clue what vaule he brings to the world right now but they are recording the end of the world to document for whom?

customCards.name: Camp Mage
customCards.desc: Camp mages help fight off base-level anomalies; the SCP Foundation would call them safe class. These are still mages in training as they just got their source mage.

customCards.name: Gokien
customCards.desc: An alien that those guys who went missing on those podcasts were talking about. This is what the US government has been hiding from us. This thing can crush a truck with its mind.

customCards.name: Grey Dragon protector of D.R
customCards.desc: A man who comes from the Dragonic Realm, he came to Earth looking for the elemental spirit fire boy to respark the flame within the dragon crystal in the Dragonic Realm after the fire went out and the realm has been overrun by demons since the awakening of Abraxas.

customCards.name: Flaming Egg Of The Sun
customCards.desc: This egg is said to give birth to the flames of the sun. How is that possible when the sun has flames now?

customCards.name: Flaming Peacock of the Sun
customCards.desc: Legends say that this peacock is the mother of the sun and where the sun actually gets its flame from. The SCP Foundation has done countless amounts of research on it, and it is said this is not its true form and that its true form was created by Abraxas and aided in the creation of humanity. So this thing is God?

customCards.name: flaming phoenix of the sun
customCards.desc: it is said that this is the final form of the Flaming Peacock, and this is the mother of all creation on earth. The phoenix uses its flames to give the sun the blaze we see, and that fire from the sun is where our creative minds come from—hence the theory of man creating fire.

customCards.name: Moon vulture
customCards.desc: It is said that this vulture is the reason that we have midnight. No one knows where the vulture comes from because the SCP Foundation says its origins do not connect to Abraxas or Flaming Peacock of the Sun. Something else created this shadow of darkness, bird.

customCards.name: Little Grey
customCards.desc: Little dudes who have taken a liking to old hip-hop music, as once they called it, "drill music." These guys broke into old clothing stores, and you may see some of these little guys wearing clothes. It's weird they do not attack unless you provoke them or do not listen to their music, as it puts you to sleep.

customCards.name: xenoTail
customCards.desc: Some survivors went on a mission to the lost planet, and we were told that the rocket didn't make it. The people were shocked when the rocket did come back, and then this is what jumped out: attacking NASA and some of the SCP guards, turning them into these things, and now there is an infestation of what they now call Xenotails.

customCards.name: UFbeamer
customCards.desc: A UFO—that's what the young ones will call this till this day when they spin the block. There must be some children, little greys, in here as this thing plays music that puts humans to sleep, which pisses the UFO off and makes it go on a rampage. I think it wants us to listen to its mixtape.

rebirthShift.popupText: Crash landing, a little alien appeared.

customCards.name: D Class mage
customCards.desc: These guys were sent to what is worse than prison and that is class D in the SCP Foundation, where these guys are basically test dummies. Their prayers were answered when Abraxas woke up from her nap and destroyed the world.

customCards.name: Geomax The Final One Of The B
customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: Corny Man
customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: 10,000 Year Turtle
customCards.desc: A turtle who lived 10,000 years and now has the power to destroy mountains and cities if it wanted to; luckily, we found out it is harmless.

customCards.name: Chain Ape
customCards.desc: When the SCP found out that the group Hidn Could Corp. was creating monsters out of animals, they shut the operations down. But that did not stop them from cloning their creations and using them for punishment against the people.

customCards.name: Containment Tank
customCards.desc: A containment tank with armor in it. They call it SCP-5000. I wonder why they have it behind this protected glass.

customCards.name: Dani Lion
customCards.desc: A powerful lion that is made out of nature, it is said this is Mother Nature's pet and the protector of plant life.

customCards.name: Do Do Blazer
customCards.desc: One of Hidn Clouds Corp.'s best creations, so they state. I have no clue how the hell they found this beast to make something like this out of it. It is said this thing saved America in World War 3.

customCards.name: Flytress
customCards.desc: A woman who tried to get rich selling maggots to farmers was found with her insides replaced by maggots, due to her becoming a threat in the industry. They said after the flood she came back to hunt the farming industry, killing farmers from around the world.

customCards.name: Hayyot
customCards.desc: This thing is said to be one of the scariest things to ever see in your sight; these were once a story. Abraxas made them a reality, and now we are haunted by this thing as it plays with those who view its reality as it is bright as the sun to look at.

customCards.name: Man In Black
customCards.desc: The men in black are not what Hollywood told us about. Ever since the world went to shit, these guys started popping up everywhere, and everyone that they approached has never been seen again.

customCards.name: MotherShip
customCards.desc: Did they come in peace? No, they came here looking to invade us when they thought we were at our weakest, but little did they know Abraxas already beat them to destroying us.

customCards.name: Space Jet
customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: Ra The Sun God
customCards.desc: Ra, the sun god, is one of the gods that are making wagers on the humans' bodies and their souls. I wonder what these gods are doing with our bodies and our souls.

customCards.name: Raptor Plant
customCards.desc: A raptor made out of plants, the Hidden Cloud's corp was very creative when they made these creatures. People believe they are still in operation due to the fact that weird creatures are popping up with these raptors, and they run in packs together.

customCards.name: Rose Champion
customCards.desc: A beautiful woman who happens to be made out of roses; rumors say she has a nasty side that is much uglier on the inside that hasn't been shown to the public yet.

customCards.name: SCP-5000
customCards.desc: A powerful suit that is said to be able to withstand the end of the world.

customCards.name: SCP Chopper
customCards.desc: These annoying sons of bitches bring no value to anyone. Just fly around and shoot shit.

customCards.name: Shy Guy
customCards.desc: An unstoppable force—once you look at this guy, no matter where you are or how far you are, even if you are in a different realm, he will come put an end to you. One look, just count to 3, and it will be all over.

customCards.name: Survivor Active mech
customCards.desc: A mech that was built to fight off the worst of anything out there. Killing aliens and using their tech, we finally built something that can withstand shy guy.

customCards.name: Survivor Guard Dog
customCards.desc: The camp best friend, this litte guy keeps everyone protected.

customCards.name: Survivor Guard dual blader
customCards.desc: When you see a survivor rogue, just know he's not alone.

customCards.name: Survivor Guard Mage
customCards.desc: This mage protects Camp Heights from high flyers.

customCards.name: Survivor mage monkey
customCards.desc: This monkey keeps a smile on the survivors' faces during their worst times.

customCards.name: Survivor Guard spearmen
customCards.desc: The only use case this survivor has is stopping traps from blowing up .

customCards.name: Survivor Guard Riflemen
customCards.desc: The survivor who makes sure that everyone makes it back home when he is on the job with them.

customCards.name: Survivor guard Empty Mech
customCards.desc: A empty mech suit that does nothing. I wonder what that is for.

customCards.name: Polycreation
customCards.desc: You use a lab to createa new being out of 2 or more.

customCards.name: The Crazy One
customCards.desc: Something is wrong with this guy, he's not even buckled anymore but for some reason he still act like he is.

customCards.name: The Old Man
customCards.desc: This creepy old man gives anybody who even think about it the creeps, it is said he lives in his own realm and can go anywhere traveling through it.

customCards.name: Weeds Mage
customCards.desc: I know what you're thinking; when we saw him, we thought we could smoke him, and he was the meaning of a pack. But no, he is the wizard of plants.

customCards.name: xeno Eggs
customCards.desc:
These things are nasty. The SCP found a group of them on a crashed ship, and guess what the SCP Foundation did? 
Yup, you know SCP things now. We have what they call Xenotails running crazy out here.

customCards.name: xeno Baby
customCards.desc: Is that a baby and an actual alien? That is so gross; Hidden Clouds couldn't have made this thing!

customCards.name: xenoTail The first
customCards.desc: This was the first Xenotail that has been spotted, and no one can seem to kill it; it just keeps getting up. Weapons just do not work on this thing. This is the thing that infected Zarra!

customCards.name: Yuki
customCards.desc: The biggest rogue in Hidden Cloud Corp; they say this is one of the most powerful magic users but moves like a shadow. It is said that only two people beat SCP-682 without a scare, and Yuki was one of them.

customCards.name: Street King Vip
customCards.desc: The leader of The Street Kings, the rival gang of Scum, to control the drug trade, Street King VIP has to take things to heights where Camp Heights has to watch out for them. Even the SCP Foundation walks on eggshells with the Street Kings.

customCards.name: Xenotail The first
customCards.desc: This is an npc hero

customCards.name: The Watcher
customCards.desc: These guys are said to be angels who watch over humanity. As we were recently warned, these guys are actually Archons and aren't in us humans' best interest.

customCards.name: Sight of Struggle
customCards.desc: Counter 1 attack this turn.

customCards.name: The Camps Best Friend
customCards.desc: Call upon a Survivor Guard Dog

customCards.name: Death Plant
customCards.desc: This is  a npc

customCards.name: Aqua Pup
customCards.desc: Another weird Hidden Clouds Corp. creation, it is said one of the employees used to bring her do to work and then the dog secerty ended up missing. Everyone acted like they did not know what was going on, and then this thing appeared, showing the employee love even following her home a few times. But the office kept telling her Mr. Fluffins ran away to chase his dreams.

customCards.name: ScorpiRex
customCards.desc: When the government was paying thousands for scorpion catchers, we saw what they were buying them for. It came out that the company Hidn Cloud Corp was creating these giant scorpions that were tearing American enemies apart and spraying poison gas that was making American enemies' civilization eat each other.

customCards.name: brain Jelly
customCards.desc: Hiden Cloud Corp was shut down for selling weapons to America's enemies. Whatever the hell it is was giving information to the US enemies by reading the minds of soldiers who were on navy ships.

customCards.name: SCP Guard
customCards.desc: AI NPC

customCards.name: Scum Grunt
customCards.desc: AI NPC

customCards.name: Cave Troll
customCards.desc: AI NPC

customCards.name: Giant Snake
customCards.desc: Ai NPc

customCards.name: SCP-378
customCards.desc: You have to be real down bad to call on this guy.

customCards.name: That Code Hard Cinder
customCards.desc: When a unit use their effect you can use this card to negate it.

customCards.name: SCP-001 Gate Guardian.
customCards.desc: This thing can be seen anywhere in the world; it looks like it is protecting something, but no one knows what. Everyone that was said to have gotten close does not remember anything after hearing the words "Leave" in their mind so loud it almost burst their eardrums.

customCards.name: Survivor Spirt
customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: ualti Element Magician
customCards.desc: A creation of the Forge.

customCards.name: StinkShark
customCards.desc: America's secret weapon when it came to invading their enemies: this thing would fly in the air and would act as a countrywide EMP.
handEffects: Can play this card free if it is a lighting storm.

customCards.name: Blazing Tigershark
customCards.desc: A war weapon that was made and sold to aid America in the war of World War III when the US went and attacked Russia. Russia didn't know what America had for them, as this creature heat around its body attracts all missiles. It was nothing that Russia could do, as it was turning non-homing missiles into homing missiles for this thing.
handEffects: This card can be played for free if it is extremely hot outside and the sun is harsh.

customCards.name: Batcoon
customCards.desc: There was a zombie outbreak that happened in Russia; they purchased 4 of these things from Hidn Cloud Corp and within less than 24 hours that outbreak was over. It is said these are the most deadly things that you can run into, they run in packs and if you see one you are dead.
handEffects: If the moon is covered with blood, you can play this card for free.

customCards.name: Elemental Leaper
customCards.desc: When the SCP Foundation shutdown hid Cloud Corp, well, they thought they did. Cloud Corp created this beast using all of the DNA of all of the weapons that they did create to release this on humanity, and let's just say this was the first time the world almost ended. Abraxas came and finished the job.
